parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the workspace. If this parameter is not specified, the default workspace is accessed. You can obtain the key on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Async
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to initiate an asynchronous task. Valid values:

- **true**: Initiate an asynchronous task.
- **false**: Do not initiate an asynchronous task.

parameters.name: KnowledgeId
parameters.description: The ID of the FAQ to publish.
